scoringMethod: Evidence-based review of the hardened working tree. Credit is limited to implemented behavior supported by the final mocked test suite and local quality gates. Artifact-tool render/inspect, browser visual QA, physical Safari/iPad behavior, real providers, production latency, remote environment variables, executed migrations and remote RLS remain unverified and therefore prevent a full score or a production-ready verdict.

dimensions.name: Seguridad y privacidad
evidence: Every provider-facing tool result passes through a strict per-tool field allowlist; unknown fields are dropped and only a sanitized counter is retained.
The exact mocked OpenAI payload snapshot excludes raw_data, normalized_data, raw_value, UUIDs, emails, filenames, storage paths, finance, customers, suppliers, notes and unknown properties.
Safe AI logging hashes the user identifier and retains only allowlisted operational metadata; tests prove that questions, answers, MPNs, filenames and sensitive values are absent.
The system prompt treats database and file content as untrusted data, escapes closing delimiters, forbids free SQL, protects permissions and does not let the model select a tool.
Sensitive finance requests are denied for every role, and AI data tools use the authenticated Supabase client without service-role bypasses or mutations.
Conversation memory is owner-scoped in code and in an additive migration with forced RLS and no admin bypass.
risks: The new conversation RLS policies and retention function have not been applied or exercised against a remote Supabase environment.
Remote environment configuration, provider retention behavior and production stdout retention were intentionally not verified.

dimensions.name: Integración con Opportunity Finder
evidence: The assistant now reads authenticated, owner-scoped opportunity_finder_jobs and opportunity_finder_results instead of recalculating the matcher.
The V2 tool enforces completed status, compatible pipelineVersion, explicit job ownership, server-controlled filters, pagination and hard limits.
It supports latest and selected jobs, general summary, full sale, partial sale, sourcing, inventory without demand, exact MPN, usable availability, exact quantity, review and invalid quantities.
The legacy aggregate engine is reachable only through an explicit historical-company intent and is not mixed with Opportunity Finder V2.

Set 01 code-level parity passed for AI, CSV and XLSX across ES, EN and ZH with 11 exact MPNs, 9 usable matches, 5 exact quantities, 8 full sales, 2 partial sales, 2 sourcing cases, 1 inventory-without-demand case, 1 review and 1 invalid quantity.
Tests preserve leading-zero and hyphenated MPN text and prove that stock is not reused across dated requirements.
risks: Artifact-tool inspect and render could not run because the spreadsheet runtime lacked sandboxPolicy, so the physical Set 01 workbooks were not visually revalidated.
Owner isolation and persisted-result parity have not been exercised against remote RLS or a deployed UI/export flow.

dimensions.name: Exactitud de intención
evidence: A central typed catalog declares aliases in ES, EN and ZH, priority, parameters, server tool, permission, clarification and positive/negative examples for the required intents.
The deterministic router tolerates accents, case and small spelling variations, reports confidence and asks for clarification when candidates are close.
Help no longer falls through to business-record search, full-sale language is not treated as generic, and the model cannot override the server-selected tool.
MPN extraction preserves leading zeros and hyphens.
risks: Future business vocabulary additions will require catalog and regression-test maintenance.

dimensions.name: Multidioma
evidence: Deterministic help, Opportunity Finder, denial, empty, clarification, timeout, rate-limit, error and voice messages exist in Spanish, English and simplified Chinese.
Detectable question language takes precedence over the UI preference, which remains a fallback.
Equivalent ES, EN and ZH Opportunity Finder questions select the same server tool and return identical Set 01 counts.
Localized HTTP and voice-path tests cover the three supported languages without real provider calls.
risks: No native-speaker acceptance review or browser visual inspection of all translated states was completed.
Remote font and rendering behavior for simplified Chinese remains unverified.

dimensions.name: Robustez de API
evidence: Strict schemas enforce JSON content type, non-empty input, a 2000-character ceiling, supported language and UUID-form job/conversation identifiers.
Mocked HTTP tests cover 400, 401, 403, 404, 413, 422, 429, 502, 503 and 504 responses with no-store headers and sanitized bodies.
Tool and provider operations have bounded configurable timeouts, one retry at most for eligible idempotent transient failures, and parent-signal cancellation.
User cancellation is distinguished from timeout, successful responses omit traceId and internal failures are not converted into normal HTTP 200 JSON success responses.
Voice routes validate Content-Length before multipart parsing when available and validate size, MIME and empty audio.
risks: Once an SSE response has started, a later failure must be represented by a terminal stream event rather than a new HTTP status.
Production proxy body limits, connection cancellation and rate-limit storage were not exercised end to end.

dimensions.name: Memoria, streaming y experiencia
evidence: An additive migration defines owner-only conversations and messages, forced RLS, retention expiry, soft deletion and content constraints without tool payload columns or admin bypass.
The model receives at most the last eight safe messages under a total character cap and excludes deleted messages and prior tool data.
Owner-scoped no-store APIs support list, create, load, append and delete behavior; isolation tests use two synthetic users.
The SSE route emits ordered validation, search, processing, generation and completion progress and stops without persisting an assistant response after cancellation.
The widget supports cancellation, copy, new conversation, history, deletion, source/evidence labels and data-based versus AI-generated indicators.
React tests cover dialog semantics, accessible labels, aria-live behavior, Escape, focus trapping, keyboard navigation and bounded emulated iPad dimensions.
risks: The memory migration and RLS policies were not executed remotely, as required by the task constraints.
Browser visual QA was blocked by the unavailable browser runtime, and physical iPad behavior was not tested.

dimensions.name: Voz
evidence: Visible localized consent identifies OpenAI transcription and ElevenLabs synthesis before use.
Audio routes apply early configurable size checks, MIME and empty-file validation, transcription-length limits, provider timeouts, cancellation and no-store responses.
TTS input removes UUIDs, emails and unnecessary sensitive text, successful responses omit traceId and no audio is written by the application.
Mocked tests cover valid and empty transcription, oversize and invalid MIME, OpenAI and ElevenLabs timeouts, disabled TTS, playback, cancellation, text fallback and emulated iPad dimensions.
risks: OpenAI and ElevenLabs were mocked and their live contracts, retention behavior and remote credentials were intentionally not verified.
MediaRecorder, playback and cancellation were not tested on physical Safari, iPad or iPhone hardware.

dimensions.name: Rendimiento
evidence: Opportunity Finder reads persisted aggregate results with pagination and does not execute or import matcher code.
The AI stock-needs path selects only safe fields, excludes raw_data and normalized_data, applies database filters and uses one bounded query rather than per-upload N+1 queries.
Explicit row, page, example and serialization limits bound provider context and process memory.
The deterministic mocked P95 contract completes under two seconds and tests assert every tool's hard limit.
risks: Real production P95, database plans, concurrent load and process memory were not measured.
Remote data distribution may require further indexing or limit tuning after staging load tests.

dimensions.name: Observabilidad
evidence: Sanitized AI events track requests, success, error, timeout, cancellation, rate limit, intent, tool, provider, duration, token usage, fallback, language and text/voice channel.
Successful AI info events are persisted, warn-level failures contribute to error metrics and average latency includes the full accepted event set.
Metrics group by intent, tool, provider, language and channel without retaining questions or answers.
An additive reversible retention function validates a 1-to-365-day window, is service-role restricted and intentionally installs no remote schedule.
risks: The retention migration was not executed and no remote schedule or operations runbook was installed.
Production dashboard completeness, log sink retention and provider token reporting remain unverified.

dimensions.name: Pruebas y QA
evidence: The final full mocked suite passed 90 test files and 416 tests, adding 106 tests over the 310-test baseline.
Unit, router, privacy, adversarial, HTTP, permission, Opportunity Finder, ES/EN/ZH, memory, streaming, UI, voice, logging, rate-limit and timeout coverage passed.
TypeScript typecheck, ESLint and the production build passed.
Acceptance tests cover all required HTTP statuses, owner isolation, manager scope, finance denial, provider payload privacy, read-only tools, cancellation and safe fallback.
Set 01 code-level AI, CSV and XLSX parity passed without changing the certified Opportunity Finder suite.
risks: Artifact-tool inspect/render and browser visual QA were blocked by missing runtime sandboxPolicy support.
No remote RLS, live-provider, physical-device or production-load test was performed.
